```
import type { Meta, StoryObj } from '@storybook/angular-vite';
import { fn } from 'storybook/test';

import { ButtonComponent } from './button.component';

// More on how to set up stories at: https://storybook.js.org/docs/writing-stories
const meta: Meta<ButtonComponent> = {
  title: 'Example/Button',
  component: ButtonComponent,
  tags: ['autodocs'],
  argTypes: {
    backgroundColor: {
      control: 'color',
    },
  },
  // Use `fn` to spy on the onClick arg, which will appear in the actions panel once invoked: https://storybook.js.org/docs/essentials/actions#story-args
  args: { onClick: fn() },
};

export default meta;
type Story = StoryObj<ButtonComponent>;

// More on writing stories with args: https://storybook.js.org/docs/writing-stories/args

  args: {

    label: 'Button',

};

  args: {
```

```
import type { Preview } from '@storybook/angular-vite';
import { applicationConfig } from '@storybook/angular-vite';
import { providePrimeNG } from 'primeng/config';
import { provideRouter } from '@angular/router';
import Aura from '@primeuix/themes/aura';
import '../src/styles.css';
import './styles.css';

const preview: Preview = {
  decorators: [
    applicationConfig({
      providers: [
        provideRouter([]),
        providePrimeNG({
          theme: {
            preset: Aura,
            options: {
              cssLayer: {
                name: 'primeng',
                order: 'theme, base, primeng'
              },
              // Override font to use sans-serif instead of Times New Roman
              cssVariables: {
                'primary-font-family': '-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif'
              }
            }
          }
        }),
      ],
    }),
  ],
  parameters: {
    controls: {
      matchers: {
        color: /(background|color)$/i,
        date: /Date$/i,
      },
    },

    a11y: {
      // 'todo' - show a11y violations in the test UI only
      // 'error' - fail CI on a11y violations
      // 'off' - skip a11y checks entirely
      test: 'todo',
    },
  },
};

export default preview;

```

 types the default export.  types each named story export.

## 2. 

From `src/app/shared/components/ui-card/ui-card.stories.ts`. It adds Angular  to the story's test module, so child components and directives resolve:

```ts
import { Meta, StoryObj, moduleMetadata } from '@storybook/angular-vite';
import { ButtonModule } from 'primeng/button';
import { UiCard, UICardImports } from './ui-card';

const meta: Meta<UiCard> = {
  title: 'Shared / UI Card',
  component: UiCard,
  tags: ['autodocs'],
  decorators: [
    moduleMetadata({
      imports: [UICardImports, ButtonModule],
    }),
  ],
};

export default meta;
type Story = StoryObj<typeof meta>;
```

## 3. 

No story in `src` declares  today. Global providers live in `.storybook/preview.ts` through , which wraps every story:

```ts
decorators: [
  applicationConfig({
    providers: [provideRouter([]), providePrimeNG({ /* ... */ })],
  }),
],
```

For a single component,  accepts  too. This is illustrative, with `ExampleService` as a placeholder:

```ts
const meta: Meta<DealDetailCard> = {
  title: 'Features/Deals/DealDetailCard',
  component: DealDetailCard,
  decorators: [
    moduleMetadata({
      providers: [{ provide: ExampleService, useValue: { getDeal: () => of(mockDeal) } }],
    }),
  ],
};
```

Use a story-level  array to override providers for a single story.

## 4.  and 

From `src/app/features/deals/ui/deal-status-badge/deal-status-badge.stories.ts`, a `select` control with options:

```ts
argTypes: {
  stage: { control: 'select', options: stages },
},
```

```
   - Import `Meta` and `StoryObj` from `@storybook/angular-vite`, and the component from `./${TM_FILENAME_BASE}` with the `.stories` part stripped.

Phase 3 - Block snippets (parallel with each other, depends on 1)
```
